rationale: unit:shared.correspondence states both directions of one-step execution equivalence and explicitly quantifies over arbitrary Shared successors. lean:Correspondence/UniqueShared:step_correspondence has exactly that scope: its left side fixes only the initial configuration to embedConfiguration before, and its right side produces a Given successor whose embedding equals the otherwise unrestricted Shared after. There is no premise that after is already an embedding and no well-formedness assumption narrowing the stated arbitrary-class-table claim. unit:shared.embedding introduces E and its state/program components; given.steps and shared.steps introduce the two step judgments. The selected embedClasses now assigns classType to every Given declaration. Kind.mode therefore keeps constructor results unique and StructArguments is vacuous on this embedded fragment; embedValue never introduces giveShare. The selected Step rules preserve the fresh-variable requirement, code tail, left-to-right constructor evaluation, and allocation counter representation. Thus the new struct guards and immediately-shared constructors neither exclude an embedded Given step nor admit extra successors. The unit claims single-variable binding correspondence only; unpacking, finite traces, and boundary statements have separate units and are not silently included in this decision.
limitations: This review was performed by the author of the change, not a fresh independent reviewer.
